rows.resolution_note: The Table 1 lymphoma row line gives sample size 361,194 with author Neale lab, year 2018, European ancestry and consortium UK Biobank: the exact release N with its year matches exactly one dictionary row. The other UK Biobank row line of Table 1 (lymphoid leukemia, 372,776, Burrows 2021) is a second outcome GWAS whose N equals no dictionary row's, so under rule H it identifies no other release and is not a conflict; the remaining passages use UK Biobank for individual-level validation and name no release.
